referee_caveats_inferred: Redshift rests on photometry plus one ambiguous line; the MBB fit fixes z=7.455 and the dust temperature depends on it
Dusty-region magnification mu_d comes from the ALMA peak position mapped through a model fitted to F444W only, so astrometric offsets between ALMA and JWST propagate
Stellar SFR spans two dex across SED tools, so the starburst conclusion for the disk depends on template choice
SPIRE 250 um flux is 16.58 mJy in the text but 15.58 mJy in the photometry table
Lens-model uncertainties and priors are not given in enough detail to judge the 'disk' morphology claim
Band 4 and Band 3 beams are 1.3-1.6 arcsec, so ALMA photometry of the counter image is blended there
